en: Soldier: head yellow brown and stout, the capsule almost rectangular with parallel sides. Fontanelle a distinct circular pit. Labrum semicircular, the front margin setose. Mandibles very robust, short and strongly curved, the inner margins armed with a large basal tooth and a smaller median one. Antennae twelve to thirteen segmented. Pronotum saddle-shaped, wider than long, the anterior margin with a shallow notch and the posterior margin nearly straight. Alate: body dark brown; wings with the median vein unbranched. Recorded from southern China in dead wood, where colonies are small.
soldier: 头壳栗褐而带红，前胸背板栗褐，腹部淡褐黄。头壳呈长方形，光泽较强。囟平坦，几乎不突起。触角十五至十六节，第一节稍大于第三节，第三节约为第二节的两倍。上唇接近方形。上颚端部略弯，下颚内颚叶缘毛九根。前胸背板前缘以宽V形凹入，中央又作U形切入，后缘中央接近平直，中凹率百分之二十一至百分之二十四，中线隐约可见。
